subject: general
question: Which of the following terms in the 5S concept refers to making a habit of maintaining the established procedures?
solution:
The correct answer is __Sustain**(Option 2)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Sustain__ is a key term in the 5S concept.
 
• Sustain refers to making a habit of maintaining the established procedures.
 
• It ensures that the improvements achieved in the previous steps are maintained over time.
 
• Regular audits and training sessions are conducted to reinforce good practices.
 
• The goal is to embed 5S principles into the organizational culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Sort:**

 
 
• Sort refers to removing unnecessary items from the workspace.
 
• It helps in decluttering and organizing.
 
 
 
• **Set:**
 
 
• Set involves arranging items systematically for easy access.
 
• It focuses on efficiency and organization.
 
 
 
• **Shine:**
 
 
• Shine refers to cleaning the workspace to enhance productivity and safety.
 
• It involves maintaining cleanliness regularly.
